The bundled Qt modules are from Qt Base, Qt SVG and Qt Image Formats.
PySide6 Essentials and Shiboken6 provide the Python bindings and runtime.
See licenses/Qt-LGPL-3.0.txt and licenses/Qt-GPL-3.0.txt. The GPL text
accompanies the LGPL text as required by its terms. See the Qt source for
module and file notices. The component attribution index and license

Other components
----------------
The .dist-info folders beside this notice retain the wheel metadata and
included license files, including the NumPy wheel's notices for OpenBLAS,
LAPACK and compiler runtime components. LIGHTKEEPER-LICENSE.txt contains
the MIT notice for the LightKeeper USB650 protocol adaptation.

Corresponding source
--------------------
CzernyScope-<version>-third-party-source.zip is the source asset for Qt,
Qt for Python, native libusb and libusb-package. Open the GitHub release
that matches the version shown under Help > About CzernyScope. The
source manifest identifies the original archives and revisions.

https://github.com/Fisicas/CzernyScope/releases

Replacing the LGPL libraries
-----------------------------
The applicable LGPL terms cover modifying the libraries and reverse
engineering to debug those modifications. You can use compatible modified
library builds with this application.

1. Close CzernyScope. Make a copy of the portable application folder, or
   open the installed folder (normally
   %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\CzernyScope). These paths are relative to
   CzernyScope.exe. Keep backups of the original library files.
2. Replace Qt6 DLLs in _internal\PySide6 and any corresponding plugin DLLs
   in _internal\PySide6\plugins. Keep the Qt DLLs, plugins and bindings
   ABI-compatible with each other and use Windows x64 builds.
3. PySide6 and Shiboken6 are loaded from _internal\PySide6 and
   _internal\shiboken6. These folders hold the external Python files,
   Python extension modules (.pyd), and binding runtime DLLs. Build
   replacements for the bundled Qt and CPython 3.12 Windows x64 ABI.
   Keep compatible PySide6 and Shiboken6 builds together.
4. Replace native libusb at _internal\libusb_package\libusb-1.0.dll
   with a Windows x64 libusb-1.0 DLL exporting the compatible API.
5. Restart CzernyScope. Use --demo Maya2000Pro to check the plot with
   simulated data. The installer refreshes _internal during upgrades.
   Store custom libraries outside the app folder and check compatibility
   before reapplying them after an upgrade.
